direction: Exploration bonuses in sparse-reward gridworlds: epsilon-greedy Q-learning versus count-based bonuses versus a random-network-distillation style novelty bonus (small numpy or torch networks), on chain and multi-room gridworlds of increasing size. Measure steps to first reward and final return, and test the known failure case of novelty bonuses under a 'noisy TV' state.

notes.note: 400 main runs (10 systems x 8 tasks x 5 seeds) from commit 24c3e27; old rows superseded
RND normaliser variants on all tasks, clip/K/beta sweeps (80 runs), pilot logged (12)
tables, tests, figures, verdict rebuilt by experiments/build_results.sh
6 pages, 13 verified references, audit round 2 fixes; READY

decisions.decision: Bonus is centred (bonus - 1) for all bonus systems: with Q initialised to 0 and a non-negative bonus, visited actions get Q>0 and unvisited stay at 0 so greedy never explores; pilot on seed 100 showed 0/6 systems finding the reward on chain_40/room_6 without it. Pilot used seed 100 (not an evaluation seed); beta=0.1 fixed afterwards. Before the first reward the Q-values are linear in beta so steps_to_first_reward is invariant to beta; beta only matters after reward.
Step budgets 30k (chain) / 100k (room); steps_to_first_reward censored at the budget when no reward found; 5 seeds (0-4); runs are seconds each so all cells are run.
Beta and K sweeps are sensitivity sweeps (groups sweep_beta, sweep_K) run with the method/baseline names, so only rnd_nonorm is listed as an ablation in research.yaml.

Audit round 2: the RND normaliser e/(sigma+1e-8) blew up to 1e6-1e7 when the first errors coincided (sigma=0). Repair fixed a priori, not tuned: no intrinsic signal (b=1) for the first 64 errors, then b=min(e/(sigma+1e-8),5). The old normaliser stays as ablation 'RND, unguarded normaliser (v1)', with warm-up-only and clip-only variants to isolate which guard matters, and a clip sweep.

All runs are repeated from one commit containing the code and old rows superseded, so every live row has matching provenance; RND ablation variants are logged in group main (kind ablation) so rh compare can test them against the method without duplicating method runs; sweep cells at default values reuse the main runs.
